g.text: password_hash OR auth_provider_id must be present.
The schema permits zero or one state per word.
Composite FK enforces the word owner;
user_id has no separate FK to users.
database deletion for accounts marked deleted.
No FK links a generated question to words;
matching word text is not a database relationship.
No user or session foreign key.
= NOT NULL; unmarked fields are nullable
PK = primary key; FK = foreign key; UK = single-column unique key
|| = exactly one; o| = zero or one; o{ = zero or many
CASCADE = ON DELETE CASCADE; other links have no explicit ON DELETE action
UUID = SQLAlchemy Uuid (native UUID or CHAR(32), depending on database)
TIMESTAMP (UTC) = application UTCDateTime, backed by a timezone-aware DateTime type
words.word, normalised_word and english_explanation must not be blank
Application tables only; Alembic migration bookkeeping is omitted
